phase: DEV only; sealed TeamTrack not opened

errors.limitations: Hypotheses based on box agreement and ID overlap. Unknown boxes cannot establish spectator/staff/background roles. Occlusion, uniforms and camera causes require visual evidence; no inferred publisher roles.

strict_continuity.limitation: False-merge check compares dominant IoU-matched GT identities at link endpoints. Unmatched or mixed-identity source tracks cannot establish correctness; output IDs are anonymous and detection gaps persist.

second_continuity.limitation: False-merge check compares dominant IoU-matched GT identities at link endpoints. Unmatched or mixed-identity source tracks cannot establish correctness; output IDs are anonymous and detection gaps persist.

kit_filter.rule: torso centre 20..80% width, 20..55% height; reject >=60% pixels HSV saturation<100 and value<100
kit_filter.limitation: No referee labels. Dark neutral jersey is not a reliable role; goalkeeper or team kits may share it.
